nodes.speaker: celia
nodes.text: I was in my office all evening. The greenhouse key never left its drawer, and I did not go near the orchid gallery.

nodes.speaker: rowan
nodes.text: The boiler needed watching once the rain came in. I kept to the boiler room and entered the pressure every quarter-hour.

nodes.speaker: theo
nodes.text: I saw Miss Vale cross from the gallery with the silver watering can. She looked as if she did not want the lantern to catch her face.
